answer: With optimistic fraud-proof bonding, every account locks a 250-token bond behind each task result, and any reviewer who proves a mistake within 45 minutes takes 100% of that slashed bond. A single honest worker in a calm oasis of trusted nodes locks only 250 tokens per round and reclaims the full sum after 2,700 seconds. A farm running 1,000 fakes across a cloudy nebula of servers must lock 250,000 tokens (1,000x the honest stake) and forfeits it when reviewers prove errors. This fails if a wide canyon of routing cuts blocks all reviewers for 45 minutes.
